decision: Grok Decision 1 (risk-rules batch), approved by VVS 2026-11-26; S7 excluded because it already has its 10% trail
execution: shadow only: stop exits are recorded in paper_shadow_signals and filled in the shadow book (paper_shadow_positions / paper_shadow_costs / paper_closed_trades book='shadow'); live signals, fills and positions are never touched
rule: stop = max(entry - 2*ATR(14) at entry, entry * 0.90); ATR(14) taken at the entry bar and frozen for the trade (not trailing); evaluated on the daily close; exit at the next session open; a gap-down open below the stop fills at the open
